name: Samsung Card Co., Ltd.
summary: Samsung Card Co., Ltd. provides financial services in South Korea. It operates through Credit Card, Installment and Leasing, and Other segments. The company offers card payment services, such as credit card, debit card, and pre-paid cards; short-term and long-term card loans; and installment services for electronics, consumer durables, industrial goods, and automobiles; and auto leasing, flat leasing, and rental services. It also provides general loans, debt cancellation and debt suspension, SMS notification, fraud protection, and asset-backed securitization services; insurance sales agency services; and shopping, travel, and wedding services.
